notes: Access: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (User-agent: * / Allow: /); reached via direct HTTP (curl_cffi, chrome124 TLS impersonation) which returned 200 SSR HTML for robots.txt, homepage, /house-home, /home-catalog, /shop-all-gifts, /accessories and categories_sitemap.xml - consistent with the prior Home-Decor pass's note that this site has no AAAA record and blocks plain requests/WebFetch (403) without TLS impersonation. Playwright (tier 2, headless Chromium) was blocked immediately by DataDome (CAPTCHA challenge page returned for both /search?q=pet and a known-good page /vases), so tier 2 was abandoned in favor of continuing tier 1. Checked for a dedicated Pet nav: top-level mega-nav (homepage superNav, 13 departments: New!, Top-Rated, Dresses, Clothing, Shoes, Accessories, Beauty, Home & Furniture, Gifts & Seasonal, Sale, Weddings, Maeve) has no Pets/Pet department; the deep Home & Furniture nav trees (/house-home and /home-catalog) and categories_sitemap.xml (2671 URLs) contain no pet-specific slug; common guessed slugs (/pets, /pet, /pet-shop, /pet-accessories, /dog-cat-accessories) all 404. However the /home-catalog (Shop All Home & Furniture) page's embedded search-state JSON exposes a 'Product Type' facet with a 'Pet Accessories' value and an exact count, plus two pet-specific brand facet values (Bone Dry Pet=1, Bowsers Yugen Pet=3) which are presumably a subset of that 75. A generic sitewide 'Pet':['Accessories and Apparel','Home Goods','Toys','Treats and Chews'] taxonomy string also appears repeatedly in page JSON (shared URBN-wide product-taxonomy config used for e.g. size-chart lookups) but does not correspond to any live nav/URL on this brand's site - treated as noise, not a real category. Site search (/search?q=pet, q=dog bed, q=cat toy, q=pet bowl) returned 200 but is fully client-rendered (title only, no SSR result markup or count) so it could not be used as absence/presence proof either way; navigation+sitemap+facet evidence above was used instead. After finding the Pet Accessories facet, I probed several guessed query-string formats to reach a direct filtered PLP URL for it (?type=, ?productType=, ?facet=, ?filters=, ?category=, ?refinements=) - all 7 returned 403, and a retry of the plain (previously 200) /home-catalog URL immediately after also came back 403, indicating the host had blocked the session. Per protocol, stopped requesting this host at that point; no further fetches were attempted. Net effect: solid evidence for the Pet Accessories category and its exact facet count, but no confirmed direct deep-link URL for it (flagged on the row) - link points to the aggregate Home & Furniture catalog page where the facet lives. | REDO 2026-09-02: found the real filtered-PLP URL (?attributionProductType=Pet+Accessories) via the site's own Pinia state + a live UI filter click (Claude-in-Chrome, no proxy) rather than guessing query params. Verified with a fresh hard navigation - qty still 75, matches original figure exactly. Link updated, flag cleared.

rows.evidence: Direct navigation to https://www.anthropologie.com/home-catalog?attributionProductType=Pet+Accessories server-renders "Shop all Home / 75 products" with active filter chip "Pet Accessories | Clear All"; product grid is entirely pet items (Barbour x Anthropologie dog beds/coats, dog bowls, cat trees, pet carriers, pet collars). URL param discovered from the site's own embedded urbnInitialPiniaState JSON (category.facets.tile.product.facets.attributionProductType refinement) and confirmed by clicking the live UI filter and reading window.location.href after the SPA applied it.
